method: CSS values counted per property and mapped to selectors; no --e-global / Divi global colour variables exist on this site (WordPress core presets only, unused). Colours below are the exact CSS hex values.

colours.evidence: Header bar background (.et_pb_section_1_tb_header), dropdown menu bg, all H1-H4 in text modules (color:#0090DA!important), links + underline, button hover, blue band sections (.et_pb_section_2), footer gradient end, keyholding price + border. Most frequent brand colour (20+ uses).

colours.role: text / dark neutral, primary button fill
colours.evidence: body color, default h1-h6 color, buttons background-color (.et_pb_button_*, .mh-kh__btn), Gravity Forms submit button; hover turns #0090DA.

colours.role: white: logo, text on blue, cards
colours.evidence: Logo glyphs, button text, menu text on blue header, cards (.mh-kh).
rgba(99,127,137,0.19) border-color on buttons, pagination colour.
FAQ expand symbol colour only (2 uses). Not a core brand colour.

colours_ignored.#2EA3F2, #666666, #333333: Divi framework defaults (not overridden brand values)
colours_ignored.#580473: Divi default #main-header colour, not rendered (theme-builder header is #0090DA)

contrast_wcag.#FFFFFF on #0090DA: 3.5:1 - large type only (>= 24px / bold 19px); fine for film titles, not small captions

fonts.role: body text, default headings (h1-h6 base), buttons (letter-spacing 0.08em), blockquotes at weight 800
fonts.notes: weight 800 is the most used explicit weight (18x); custom card headings/prices 800; uppercase tags 800 with 1.2-1.4px tracking
fonts.file_type: variable font, wght axis 100-900 (one file covers all weights; latin subset includes Á U+00C1)

fonts.role: display headings: h1 96px, h2 60px, h3 40px, h4 28px, small kicker h5/h6 18-22px (soft, rounded serif-ish display)

logo_wordmark_typeface: The logo lettering is NOT Montserrat or Calistoga: a heavy rounded geometric display face (rounded-bottom W, curly y). Closest open font by eye: Righteous (Google Fonts, OFL) - unverified. Always use the PNG for the wordmark; never retype it.

logo.description: House-shaped outline (gable roof) enclosing a block letter H, beside a two-line wordmark 'MÁLAGA' / 'HIDEAWAY'. Supplied by the site only as a WHITE PNG with a baked-in soft dark drop shadow, shown on the #0090DA header bar. No SVG and no coloured version exist on the site.

files.blue_clean: assets/logo/malaga-hideaway-logo-blue.png (#0090DA, derived by recolouring the glyph alpha)

logo.derived_note: blue/gray/no-shadow/mark/wordmark files are derived from the official white PNG (alpha kept, colour swapped to measured brand hex); shapes unchanged.

favicon.note: The favicon is a photo of the Málaga city flag (purple/green with coat of arms), not a brand mark - do not use as a logo.

ui_shapes.card_accent: 6px solid #0090DA left border on keyholding card
